reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Needs Response Project: Developing Local Capacities for Education - Phase II

description.narrative: 300 beneficiaries of hearing aids 582 administrative staff benefited from equipment in 27 schools and centers for the care and rehabilitation of people with disabilities 4486 beneficiaries joined rehabilitation centers 2025 male and female students and 181 educational and administrative staff were able to access school equipment in 22 literacy centers 582 educational staff benefited from capacity building programs

Building institutional capacities of government centers and schools working in the fields of protection, care and rehabilitation of persons with disabilities and literacy schools by preparing an educational environment that enhances opportunities for participation in supporting the outcomes of the education system for persons with disabilities and literacy students

Supporting 8975 beneficiaries through: - Capacity building and development program for children with disabilities - School equipment for literacy and elderly education schools - Capacity development of educational and administrative staff
